words.example: The etymology of "salary" goes back to salt.
The English lexicon grows by thousands of words yearly.

example_translations.ru: Словарный состав английского языка ежегодно пополняется тысячами слов.
example_translations.uz: Ingliz tilining lug'at boyligi har yili minglab so'zlarga ko'payadi.

words.example: He wrote in the vernacular, not in Latin.

example_translations.uz: U lotin tilida emas, xalq tilida yozgan.

words.example: In sailors' parlance, the kitchen is the galley.

words.example: "Gonna" is colloquial; write "going to" in essays.

example_translations.uz: Bir necha yil oldingina "selfie" neologizm edi.

words.example: "Break the ice" is a common English idiom.
